decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/ The erection of part single, two storey front  and side and rear roof extensions,  would, by reason of the size, position and appearance  of the forward extension in relation to  neighbouring residential properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the street scene and is contrary to the Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New Development)  and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  Unitary Development Plan, (2003) and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.
     
2/ The lack of any off street parking provision could lead to additional on street parking which would lead to conditions  prejudicial to pedestrian safety and to the free flow of traffic contrary to  policy  T 1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments) of the  Unitary Development Plan, (2003).
description: Erection of part single, two storey front and side and rear roof extensions to existing house
